The 1974 induction of "inner anamnesis" by the Golden Fish sign.
The 2-74 "withdrawal of assent" which caused 1974 California to disappear.

biography_events.event: Writes that he and Roger Zelazny are planning to collaborate on Deus Irae from a 1964 outline Dick had been unable to complete alone.

biography_events.event: In 1970, PKD wrote 3 letters to Roger Zelazny, turning the correspondence into a sustained discussion of family and relationship strain, the science-fiction community, and religion and theology.
In 1975, PKD wrote 13 letters to Jack Scovil, turning the correspondence into a sustained discussion of publishing and career pressures, money and royalty problems, and the science-fiction community.

In 1975, PKD wrote 7 letters to Paul Williams, turning the correspondence into a sustained discussion of metaphysics and philosophy, visions and revelatory experience, religion and theology, the science-fiction community, publishing and career pressures, and drugs and altered states.
Reports to Nancy and Isa Hackett that Roger Zelazny has finally mailed his completed Deus Irae material, making a full rough draft available.
biography_events.source: Selected Letters 1975-1976, letter to Nancy and Isa Hackett, July 2, 1975

biography_events.event: In 1976, PKD wrote 3 letters to Uwe Anton, turning the correspondence into a sustained discussion of the science-fiction community.
VALIS manuscript sells to Bantam for $10,000; DEUS IRAE paperback for $11,500 (US) and $9,000 (UK); PKD owes IRS $4,050 from the resulting income.
Realizing Zebra/Ubik wrote his novels.
